Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HelioCare is excited to move forward with the 6-month pilot. We reviewed the SOW your team sent (attached) and have two asks from procurement/legal before we sign: 

1) Offramp insurance: a short-term path to reduce committed capacity if adoption stalls in months 2–3, and a formula for a pro-rated credit rather than a full termination fee.
2) Ramp vesting: a defined ramp schedule with graduated unit guarantees for months 1–6 and a clear opt-out window tied to usage thresholds.

Our general ask is: can Redwood offer a downsell protection that lets us reduce committed capacity by up to 30% after month 3 with a credit applied to the remaining term (rather than full early termination)? We can accept a small premium or a modest performance-based discount in exchange.

I attached the SOW with our procurement notes. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps. We need to finalize terms this week to keep our internal kickoff on track.

Jenna — thanks for the clear asks and for getting the SOW back quickly. We want to keep HelioCare moving forward; below is the internal exception I'm proposing for approval. If we get sign-off today we can issue an amendment and keep the kickoff.

Summary of proposed exception (for exec/legal approval):
- Ramp window: months 1–3 are the primary ramp period; months 4–6 are stabilization.
- Downsell protection: Customer may reduce committed capacity by up to 30% after month 3 if 7-day trailing usage is below 40% of the committed baseline.
- Credit mechanics: Remaining committed spend (after reduction) will be credited at a rate of 50% of the unused committed portion, applied as a one-time credit to remaining invoices. No retroactive refunds.
- Opt-out notice: HelioCare must provide 30 days written notice before the reduction takes effect; reduction applies to remainder of term.
- Pricing concession: In exchange, we propose a temporary ramp discount of 10% on token rates for months 1–3.

Risks/ops notes:
- Adds revenue downside compared with standard termination fees; reduces collections risk if usage drops but preserves ongoing relationship.
- Requires a one-off amendment and a short attachment (ramp-plan-helio.xlsx) describing how usage is measured and the baseline calculation.

Attachments: ramp-plan-helio.xlsx (measurement + baseline proposal)

Can we get a quick go/no-go from Deal Desk / Execs? Marissa — marking for deal-desk review; Vivek — can you confirm whether leadership is comfortable with the credit level and 30-day opt-out?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
